role: Lures an animal to a player holding the tempt item (carrot for pigs, wheat for cows and sheep, seeds for chickens): after a 100-tick cooldown it follows the closest player within 10 blocks until within 2.5 blocks.

members.name: continueExecuting
members.note: the scaredByPlayerMovement branch (the 6-block movement and 5-degree look deltas) is not implemented; the native comment records that every tempting animal is built with scaredByPlayerMovement false, so it calls shouldExecute again, which matches the enabled path

members.note: isRunning = true, saves and clears avoidsWater

members.name: resetTask
members.note: clears the path, delayTemptCounter = 100, isRunning = false, restores avoidsWater

members.name: updateTask
members.note: looks at the player (eye height 1.62) at 30/40, clears the path within 2.5 blocks, otherwise re-paths to the player

members.name: isRunning
members.note: its only caller is EntityOcelot (switched off)
